backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, tool favorites, usage tracking, and integrating blob storage and access control mixins with permission-based authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting homepage reorganization, new tools section, and gradient background generation with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including blog, forum, legal pages, tool components, utilities, hooks, and configuration files with TanStack Router integration.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark themes including sidebar, chart, and UI component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the Worldsathi.com Tools Portal application.
frontend/README.md: Project documentation describing the 125+ tools portal built on Internet Computer with React/Motoko, listing features, prerequisites, and installation instructions.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for homepage, dashboard, category pages, and 8 essential tool pages wrapped in ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/Breadcrumbs.tsx: Breadcrumb navigation component displaying hierarchical path with home icon and chevron separators using TanStack Router Links.
frontend/src/components/Button.tsx: Reusable button component with CVA variants (primary, secondary, ghost) and sizes (sm, default, lg, icon) supporting hover/active animations.
frontend/src/components/CategoryBadge.ts: Badge component displaying category icon and name with optional subcategory, using category lookup from constants.
frontend/src/components/CategoryCards.ts: Displays a grid of category cards with icons, descriptions, and tool counts, filtering to show only categories that have associated tools. Each card links to the category detail page and includes hover animations.
Provides sorting controls (name, popularity, recent) and displays active filters with clear/remove functionality for category pages.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHero.tsx: Renders a hero banner for category pages with a gradient background image, category icon, name, and description with decorative overlay elements.

frontend/src/components/FeaturedToolsSec: Reusable component that displays up to 6 featured tools in a grid layout with star badges and customizable section title.

frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Site footer with logo, tool links, quick links, and attribution including Caffeine.ai referral link and copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Sticky header with logo, navigation links, theme switcher, and Internet Identity login/logout functionality with mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/layout/Layout.ts: Main layout wrapper that includes header, breadcrumbs, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/ThemeSwit: Toggle button to switch between light and dark themes using next-themes with sun/moon icons.

frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Sidebar container component that stacks TrendingTools, QuickCategoryShortcuts, and RecentBlogPosts components with sticky positioning.
frontend/src/components/sidebar/QuickCat: Sidebar card displaying clickable category shortcuts with icons for categories that have associated tools.
frontend/src/components/sidebar/RecentBl: Sidebar card showing three mock recent blog posts with thumbnails and titles (placeholder for future blog implementation).
frontend/src/components/sidebar/Trending: Sidebar card displaying the top 5 trending tools with icons and ranking numbers.
frontend/src/components/ToolGrid.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable, and sortable grid of tools with category filters, search input, and sorting options. Supports optional category pre-filtering via props.
frontend/src/components/ToolHero.tsx: Renders a hero banner for tool pages with a gradient background image, tool name, and category badge with overlay for text readability.
frontend/src/components/ToolIntroduction: Displays a card with an info icon and introduction text describing the tool's purpose.
frontend/src/components/TrustSignals.tsx: Shows three statistics (active users, tool count, growth status) with icons in a responsive grid to build user trust.
frontend/src/components/UsabilityGuide.t: Renders a numbered step-by-step guide card explaining how to use a tool.
frontend/src/constants/categories.ts: Defines tool category metadata including IDs, display names, icons, and descriptions for 13 categories (calculators, converters, generators, analyzers, productivity, text-tools, image-tools, data-tools, seo-tools, dev-tools, finance-tools, health-tools, misc-tools). Provides helper functions to retrieve category information by ID.
frontend/src/constants/tools.ts: Exports ALL_TOOLS array containing metadata for foundation tools including percentage calculator, BMI calculator, unit converter, currency converter, and password generator. Each tool includes ID, name, description, category, icon path, tags, introduction text, and usability steps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages backend actor creation with authentication, using React Query to cache actors by identity principal. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGamification.ts: Empty file placeholder for gamification-related hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and auth client lifecycle. Includes InternetIdentityProvider component and useInternetIdentity hook with status tracking.
Empty file placeholder for keyboard shortcuts functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts: React hook managing onboarding flow state with localStorage persistence, providing step navigation (next/previous), completion tracking, and skip functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profile operations (get, save), favorites management, and tool usage tracking, all using the backend actor with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUsageLimits.ts: React hook implementing daily usage limits (10 uses per tool) with localStorage persistence, tracking remaining uses, limit status, and reset date with automatic daily reset.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining comprehensive theme variables for light/dark modes including primary, secondary, accent, success, warning colors, plus gradient and shadow utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.

frontend/src/pages/tools/Analyzer1.tsx: Text analyzer tool that counts characters, words, sentences, and paragraphs with client-side processing. Uses ToolPageTemplate with FAQs and related tools.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Analyzer2.tsx: Empty file placeholder for a second analyzer tool.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Calculator1.tsx: Percentage calculator tool that computes percentage of a value with input fields, calculate/reset buttons, and result display. Includes FAQs and related tools.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Calculator2.tsx: Empty file placeholder for a second calculator tool.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Calculator3.tsx: BMI calculator tool that computes body mass index from weight (kg) and height (cm), categorizes results (underweight/normal/overweight/obese), and provides health information via FAQs.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Converter1.tsx: Unit converter tool page that converts between length units (meters, feet, inches, kilometers, miles) using conversion rates relative to meters as the base unit.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Converter2.tsx: Currency converter tool page that converts between major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR) using mock exchange rates with USD as the base currency.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Generator1.tsx: Password generator tool page that creates random passwords with customizable length and character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Generator2.tsx: QR code generator tool page that creates QR codes from text or URLs using an external API and provides download functionality.
frontend/src/pages/tools/Productivity1.t: Pomodoro timer tool page implementing a 25-minute work/5-minute break timer with start, pause, and reset controls.
frontend/src/pages/tools/ToolPageTemplat: Reusable template component for tool pages that provides consistent layout with hero section, breadcrumbs, tool interface card, FAQ accordion, related tools sidebar, and usage tracking.
frontend/src/types/tools.ts: TypeScript type definitions for tools including ToolMetadata interface with properties like id, name, description, category, icon, path, tags, and favoriteCount; also defines ToolCategory union type, ToolFilter interface, ToolSortOption type, RelatedTool and ToolFAQ interfaces.
frontend/src/utils/breadcrumbHelpers.ts: Utility function to generate breadcrumb navigation items from pathname, handling category pages (/category/:categoryId), tool pages (/tools/:toolId), dashboard, and default segment-based breadcrumbs with links to parent paths.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Common formatting utilities including relative time formatting from BigInt nanosecond timestamps, date formatting (full/short), number formatting with commas, text truncation, currency formatting, file size formatting, and reading time calculation.
frontend/src/utils/toolHelpers.ts: Utility functions for tool operations including filterTools (by search query, category, and sort option), sortTools (by name, popularity, or recency), getRelatedTools (finds tools in same category), and getToolRoute (maps tool ID to route path).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with functions to extract URL parameters, store/retrieve from sessionStorage for persistence, and clear sensitive parameters from URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom color system using HSL CSS variables (primary, secondary, accent, destructive, success, warning, muted, popover, card), custom shadows, Inter/Poppins fonts, and animation keyframes for accordions, fade-in, and slide-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state document for Worldsathi.com WordPress portal describing a mobile-first tools hub with 125+ tools, architectural notes covering WordPress/Elementor stack, WCAG accessibility, GDPR compliance, PWA features, performance optimization targets, plugin stack, and extensive image requirements for category/tool gradient backgrounds.
